t: I came here because I do not know what else to do. Please listen.
I am trying to trust you. Some days the trying is all I have.
If that good turn was yours, thank you. If it was not, thank you for listening anyway.
I do not need a sign every day. Today would be {helpful|welcome}, though.
I keep coming back here, so some part of me must believe you hear me.
I feel foolish talking to the air. I would feel worse walking away.
Maybe you helped us yesterday. I have been thinking about it since.
I cannot promise belief. I can promise I am paying attention.
They speak as if they know you. I only know that I want to.
Stay {close|near} tonight, if you are here at all.
Keep the fires low and the roofs standing tonight. We will handle the rest.
Watch the road until everyone is home. Then I will stop asking.
Thank you for an ordinary {day|morning}. We needed one.
Mind the children near the water. They move faster than anyone expects.
Let tomorrow be manageable. It does not have to be easy.
Keep watch while we sleep. We have done what we can.
There is not enough food for {tomorrow|tonight}. Please put something in our hands.
The children have eaten. The rest of us are waiting. Please hurry.
I can work hungry, but not forever. Help us fill the stores.
We have stretched the stew as far as water will take it. We need food.
Please send enough for everyone. I do not want to fight over a bowl.
I am asking plainly because hunger is plain. We need something to eat.
I am here again. I still do not know whether that means faith or habit.
You might be listening. That is enough for me to speak carefully.
I have doubts, but I brought them {here|to you} instead of keeping them home.
I will not pretend certainty. I am asking anyway.
You carried us through another day. I noticed, and I am grateful.
Keep me useful to the people around me. That is enough blessing.
I trust you with this village. Help us deserve what you give.
Thank you for staying near. The village feels it, even when nobody says so.
